svg.text: Status at HEAD 96d7048 · 2026-09-19 · design record docs/AGENT_ARCHITECTURE_V2.md §3 to §8, §13

39 components in build order: ✓ 16 shipped · ◐ 4 partial · ◌ 10 shadow · ○ 9 next. Seven turned green since 17 Sep, three of them today: the dead code retired, the source-text test locks rewritten, and the jobs table drained. The rust bar is the promotion gate; the dashed green line is where the build stands.
Build order → Phases 0, 1 shipped; Phase 2 deployed, pilot week running (each on the previous one)
→ after the gate: Phase 3, then Phase 4 (two rows landed early)

You are here: HEAD 96d7048, Phase 2 deployed, the pilot week RUNNING
Build order: 3915d81 P0 · ea48cd4 P1 · a803950 P2 · c1821e0 · 9f7ba9a · 96d7048 HEAD
The gate between Phase 2 and Phase 3 · ONE OF TWO CONDITIONS MET · both must hold before anyone is promoted off the pilot list

1. Full eval per language at or above the two-tier engine pass rate. MET: 156 of 156 run in eleven languages, 99.4% overall and 100% on action and outcome, against the engine's 100% on the shared 132.

2. One week of pilot turns with no gate firing on money copy. RUNNING: 18 real agent turns on 19 Sep, the first ever. The RECEIPT gate fired TWICE on honest answers about his own history, which reset the clean-day clock to zero; both were false positives and both are fixed (BUGLOG #77). The clock restarts on the next turn.

Since 18 Sep: the pilot gate matched one spelling of a number so the week had never started (#73); the JSON ring deleted with its erasure gap (#74); a gift could strand (#75); airtime could not be bought at all and "mine" cancelled it (#76); two true answers were suppressed (#77); airtime's flow is now proven but Blu QA vends only to four test numbers (#78); electricity defaulted a missing amount to R50 (#79).
